High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[Death Trooper]] (Virtual Set 6, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 6/Dark/Death Trooper.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aHUH3f77WP5ECVcg-bJG4WFSr-Oc1tMf/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Death Trooper.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,341,084 bytes, SHA-256 <code>cd156837240b2005ea0dc214ad94d841fb655e4708c204d87e836b598bf89896</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.5, 46.0, 73.0, 55.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V6-D-deathtrooper-2018-07-08.gif]]; this file is shown there as the High-Res Scan.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
